item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Monako
  • 発売日: 2018-04-27
  • スコア: 6.4799999999999995/10 (55 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ゴッドシスターズ
  • 英語名: God Sisters

あらすじ

The coffee shop Corleone is the oldest one in the shopping district. However, chain shops have popped up in recent years and the shop has fallen into financial trouble. Leo’s father, the shop owner, was blessed with a son and four daughters, but he became divorced when the children were still young. Leo left with his mother, while his sisters were raised by his father.

item.title: Kimi ni Semaru Otome no Lesson
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Monako
  • 発売日: 2017-09-29
  • スコア: 7.37/10 (114 人評価)
  • 日本語名: キミに迫るオトメのレッスン
  • 英語名: Kimi ni Semaru Otome no Lesson

あらすじ

Yasuto, the protagonist, is eager to find a girlfriend and have sex, but at the same time he is quite the idealist who wants a romantic, pure relation.

One day when coming back home after refusing to join a blind date his friends organise, he finds a girl in his room. The girl tells him that he has been randomly chosen to transfer into a private all-girls school for ladies in order to help them get accustomed to boys and love, as a countermeasure against low-birth rates.
